notes.title: Angel Emica ( v1.5 update )
notes.notes: [h3]Content added[/h3][list][*][p]New Clothes - Fighter. It requires the player to hold the direction key and manage 'Chi' consumption to use the skill.[/p][/*][*][p]Chip exchanger added. Allowing players to exchange chips for a higher tier and buy chips with coins. It will only appear after beating the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Silver-tier statue. Upgrading the statue to +8 to unlock. Similar to bronze-tier, it will unlock more abilities of the statue. However, it requires green chips to upgrade, which can be obtained from the 'Chip exchanger'.[/p][/*][*][p]2 new fusions have been added. [/p][list][*][p]Inquisitor ( hand gun + holy aura)[/p][/*][*][p]Angelic sword art ( Combat halo + dusk sword)[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]\[Note: These 2 fusions are available at the start, which hopefully helps new players clear the early stages of the game.][/p][h3][/h3][h3]Change and balance[/h3][list][*][p]Stage 1 background, coin icon, and pixel art for 'Clothes - angel' have been redrawn.[/p][/*][*][p]Stage 1 enemy HP has been adjusted. [/p][/*][*][p]Stage difficulty setting has been removed. \[Note: setting up for adding 'Hard mode' in the future][/p][/*][*][p]In stages, when the tower is fully charged, it needs to be manually activated to spawn the boss.[/p][/*][*][p]statue follower 'rook' and 'Shroom kid' now work differently than before.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Bug fix[/h3][list][*][p]Game crashes when fusing certain fusions. (fixed)[/p][/*][*][p]Some player attack boxes didn't work properly. (fixed)[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: version 1.4a patch
notes.notes:
[h1]Bug fix[/h1]
[h2]Endless mode[/h2]
 - Game crashes when the 'Boss-sword type' clone hits the player. (Fixed)
 - 3 bosses can't be picked in the random boss pool. (Fixed)
 - Special enemies don't give exp to the player. (Fixed)
 - The gate crystal modifier fails to work properly. (Fixed)

[h1]Improvement[/h1]
- Normal and special enemy game sprite redrawn.
- Purple shroom enemies only play 1 shooting sound effect.

[h1]Change and Balance[/h1]
- The gate crystal modifier will give random chips when the player passes 1 wave in endless mode.
- 'Dusk sword' base size increase.
- 'Sword of light' fusion materials requirement change from 3 to 2. Now just need 'Dusk sword' and 'Guardian sword'.
- Adjusting some bosses in endless mode.
